title: Closed cube in a uniform field
change: New context: external uniform field and a charge-free cube; seed asked the zero-flux result for an empty closed surface in the abstract; distractors are one face, magnitude sum, six faces.

title: Dipole inside, charge outside
change: Mixed-sign enclosed charges summing to zero with an outside charge; numbers all new; distractors include outside charge, positive-only and magnitude sum.

title: Gaussian sphere inside a charged shell
change: Spherical-symmetry shell with the Gaussian surface in the cavity; same enclosed-charge-zero concept; distractors are total charge, volume fraction, area fraction.

title: Block on a 30° frictionless incline
change: New numeric context with a 30° incline; seed was symbolic; distractors are mg, mg sinθ and mg/cosθ.

title: Ramp given by its dimensions
change: Angle is given implicitly by the ramp's dimensions, so the student must find cosθ from a 3-4-5 triangle; new numbers; same normal-force concept.

title: Incline angle measured from the vertical
change: Incline angle is given relative to the vertical, so the student must identify the angle between the surface and the horizontal first; same normal-force concept.

title: Net force from a linear velocity
change: New numeric context with linear v(t); seed asked for the expression; distractors are mv/t, mv and the missing mass.

title: Net force from a cubic velocity
change: Cubic v(t) needing a derivative evaluated at an instant; new numbers; distractors are mv/t, mv and integration instead of differentiation.

title: Net force from a position function
change: Net force from a position function requires two derivatives; new numbers; distractors are missing mass, one derivative and average acceleration.

title: Heating a rigid sealed container
change: New context with a Celsius-to-kelvin conversion for the same fixed-volume P proportional to T; seed was a pure doubling ratio; distractors are Celsius ratio, inverted ratio and unchanged pressure.

title: Extrapolating a pressure-temperature line
change: Graph-extrapolation form of the same fixed-volume P proportional to T relationship; new data; distractors are 0°C, offset error and one-interval extrapolation.

title: Tripling the pressure of a sealed gas
change: Inverse problem: find the temperature for a given pressure ratio, with kelvin conversion in both directions; same concept as the seed.
